root_idea.summary: The root centers on resorting to a place for refuge, protection, or concealment.
root_idea.development: The lexical evidence extends this core from a refuge as a place to recourse to a person, seeking aid, being driven to seek refuge, and providing protection.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Classical Arabic citation form مَلْجَأ.

senses.definition: A refuge, asylum, or place to which one resorts for protection.
senses.usage_conditions: In the supplied Quran occurrences, this noun denotes a refuge or place of resort; its surface forms are case-inflected variants of مَلْجَأ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have recourse to, betake oneself to, or repair to a thing, place, or person for refuge, protection, preservation, concealment, or lodging; to rely upon someone or seek aid from him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Commonly construed with إِلَى or إِلَيْهِ; the object may be a thing, place, or person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To decline or turn away from someone toward another to whom one has recourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction combines عَنْهُ, turning away from one person, with إِلَى غَيْرِهِ, turning to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To force or compel someone to do something against his will, including to act contrary to appearances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form II causative expresses imposed action or compulsion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave one's property to one or more heirs in preference to, or to the exclusion of, other heirs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized property and inheritance usage of the Form II verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To constrain, drive, or necessitate someone to have recourse to, betake himself to, or do something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction, commonly with إِلَى or إِلَيْهِ; it may describe driving someone to a place of refuge or to an action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To refer or commit one's affair to God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction with أَمْرَهُ and إِلَى اللّٰهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To protect or defend someone; of a place, to afford protection or refuge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form IV verb can describe either defending a person or a place providing shelter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person to whom one has recourse for protection or concealment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal extension of the refuge sense, applied to a person who serves as a safe recourse.
A figurative or tropical nominal usage.
A specialized nominal usage associated with the inheritance terminology of the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A frog, or a kind of tortoise that lives on land and in the sea.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An animal noun; the sea variety is referred to as اللَّجَأَةُ البَحْرِيَّةُ.
